message.content: I've stopped making offers for now and I'm keeping my $513 in cash. p1 has turned down two offers for Vermont ($150, then $220), and p3 wouldn't pay more than $600 for Park Place. Selling Park Place would hand p3 the dark blue set, so I'd rather hold it.
message.reasoning:
With $513 and two rejections from p1, I'm weighing other options — maybe trading p2 for Marvin Gardens since I hold Ventnor, or considering whether p3 would take Park Place at a lower price than my $650 ask, even though p3 capped it at $600, which would hand p3 the dark blues monopoly while leaving him only $338.

Trying Boardwalk from p3 seems pointless since he won't let it go, and p2 wants reds/yellows so Marvin Gardens for cash is unlikely. I think the safest move is just to end my turn and preserve my cash rather than push another doomed offer to p1.
